review_candidates.title: Sr. Policy Manager, Embedded Labs Program
review_candidates.description: Job Summary IPA's Embedded Labs put governments in the driver's seat to generate the data they need and use it to make decisions. An embedded lab is a team within a government organization working to strengthen the use of data and evidence in public policy; IPA staff work shoulder-to-shoulder with government partners to scope, incubate, and institutionalize these labs, with a portfolio that has grown to 23 Labs across 10 countries and 9 sectors, including education, finance, social protection, and gender. As the Embedded Labs Program continues to grow, the (Sr.) Policy Manager will help develop and support the program's next phase of growth across three fronts: strengthening the internal systems that let IPA teams learn from and build on each other's work, deepening external outreach that connects IPA's Labs experience to the broader policy and research community, and providing the direct support that keeps individual Lab engagements on track. The (Sr.) Policy Manager will work closely with the Senior Director of Embedded Labs to shape how the program grows, and will represent IPA in policy conversations that advance the use of data and evidence in policymaking and government program delivery. Responsibilities The (Sr.) Policy Manager will oversee the full range of the Embedded Labs Program's work. This includes: Program Delivery and Technical Support Provide technical assistance and project management support to individual Lab engagements from design through implementation, including contributing directly to the technical delivery of Lab opportunities. Support monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) efforts related to the Embedded Labs program, helping to assess the program's progress and impact and establish new best practices for government engagement. Knowledge Management, Training, and Thought Leadership Support the program's knowledge management and training efforts, including developing and delivering onboarding materials and training for both Embedded Labs staff and other IPA teams on Embedded Labs fundamentals. Generate new knowledge and public-facing outputs related to Embedded Labs, such as case studies, toolkits, and evidence reviews, and support implementation of the program's communication strategy to disseminate these outputs to internal and external audiences. Business Development and External Engagement Identify and pursue business development and fundraising opportunities in collaboration with country office and global staff, and coordinate grant reporting and deliverable management across Embedded Labs engagements. Provide coordination for strategic events such as summits, conferences, workshops, technical working groups, and roundtables, including the annual Cross-Country Learning Exchange. Qualifications Master's degree in economics, development, international relations, public administration, public policy, or a closely related field strongly preferred; will accept additional experience in place of a master's degree. 3+ years of relevant experience analyzing and communicating complex research results to various audiences, including at least 1 year of experience working closely with large NGOs or governments, preferably in an LMIC country context. Knowledge of and demonstrated experience in the use of rigorous evidence for international development policy. Strong quantitative skills, including exceptional ability to understand academic research studies and analyze bodies of research. Expertise in leading teams to draw policy lessons from research and communicating them to various audiences. Excellent communication skills, including clear, precise, non-technical written and presentation skills; requires a strong written voice and effective spoken communication and presentation style. Proven ability to multitask and successfully complete projects on tight deadlines with little supervision. Willingness to work hard, be self-motivated, and learn and adapt quickly. Experience supervising staff teams and managing multi-country projects. Strong ability to manage up and across. Experience with IPA and/or partner institutions strongly preferred. Experience as part of a government team, and/or as a researcher, and/or with monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) (preferred). Experience in education or social protection (preferred). Location Existing IPA Country Office, Full-time position. Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time. Reports To Senior Director, Embedded Labs About IPA Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA) is a research and policy nonprofit that discovers and advances what works to improve the lives of people living in poverty. IPA brings together researchers and decision-makers to design, rigorously evaluate, and refine these solutions and their applications, ensuring that the evidence created is used to improve the lives of people living in poverty. In recent decades, trillions of dollars have been spent on programs designed to reduce global poverty, but clear evidence of which programs succeed is rare, and when evidence does exist, decision-makers often do not know about it. IPA exists to bring together leading researchers and these decision-makers to ensure that the evidence we create leads to a tangible impact on the world. Since its founding in 2002, IPA has worked with over 600 leading academics to conduct over 1,000 evaluations in 52 countries. This research has informed hundreds of successful programs that now impact millions of individuals worldwide. Safeguarding at IPA At Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA), we are committed to creating a safe and respectful environment for all individuals, particularly children and vulnerable adults. As IPA adheres to strict safeguarding principles, selected candidates will be expected to adhere to these standards. By joining IPA, you become part of a team dedicated to ethical conduct, social responsibility, and meaningful impact in the fight against global poverty. Together, we work to create a better world where everyone has the opportunity to thrive with dignity and respect.
